title: Data Entry
subtitle: Enter activity data and preview emissions from the TonyAI calculation engine
noSubsidiaries: No subsidiaries accessible to your account.
notSpecifiedLegacy: Not specified (entered before fuels were tracked)
factorGeographySource: {geography}, from {source}. Change it on the Subsidiaries page.
unitHelp: This value and unit drive the emissions calculation. The engine normalises the unit (e.g. MWh → kWh) before applying the factor.
pickRequired: Pick a subsidiary, category, and enter an activity value.
draftSavedAnomalous: Draft saved — value flagged as anomalous, add a variance comment
movedDraftSavedAnomalous: Moved to {entity}, draft saved — value flagged as anomalous, add a variance comment
anomalousBeforeSubmit: This value looks anomalous — add a variance comment before submitting.
duplicateAdvice: Open it from Previous submissions to continue it.
duplicateAdviceMoving: The record has not been moved, and stays where it is.
saveFailedServer: Could not save — the server failed to process this record. Try again, and report it if it persists.
previewYearHint: This prototype's factor library currently covers {year}.
previewPrompt: Pick a subsidiary and category, then enter an activity value to see a live tCO₂e estimate.

bulkPreview.title: Accepted rows
bulkPreview.readNote: Numbers in a file are read with a point as the decimal separator: 1.234 means 1.234, not 1,234. Check each amount before you import.

conversionNote.detail: {fromUnit} → {toUnit}: ×{multiplier}. Calorific basis: {calorificBasis}. Derivation: {basis}. Reference conditions: {conditions}. Release: {publisher}, {edition} — {status}.

invalidLinkYear: This link's reporting year is not valid, so the link was not applied.
selectAllLoadedName: Select all {count} loaded: every draft you entered and can send, among the records loaded
previousShown: Showing {shown} of {total}. Selections apply to the records loaded here.
previousShownLoaded: Showing {shown} loaded. Selections apply to the records loaded here.
subsidiaryUnavailable: That subsidiary is not available to you.
recordsExist: {total} {category} records exist for {year}. Pick one from Previous submissions, or enter another period.
severalRecordsExist: Several {category} records exist for {year}. Pick one from Previous submissions, or enter another period.
notEditable: This record is {status} and can no longer be edited.
notYourRecord: This record was entered by someone else — only its author can change it.
periodLockedRecord: {period} {year} is locked — a super_admin must unlock it before this record can change.
nowEnteringNew: Now entering a new record — the one you opened is untouched.

context.title: Additional context
context.refused: A number in Additional context is not valid — correct it or clear it before saving.

anomaly.verifyAndExplain: Please verify it and explain the variance before submitting.
anomaly.variancePlaceholder: e.g. new production line commissioned this period

preview.unitConverted: Unit converted from {from} to {to} before applying the factor.
preview.invoiceRequired: You can still save and submit this entry. An invoice is required before it can be submitted, since without an emission factor the invoice is the only record of what was consumed.
preview.invoiceCompleteness: Recorded against a site for a single month, it also counts towards that site's invoice completeness — which is measured from the invoice, not from the calculated figure.

submissions.title: Previous submissions
submissions.attachStart: Attach one file to several records
submissions.attachHint: Tick the records this one document evidences.
submissions.empty: No submissions yet for this subsidiary.

move.withFigure: Saving moves this record from {from} to {to}. It is not copied — the emission factor is recalculated for its geography.
move.withoutFigure: Saving moves this record from {from} to {to}. It is not copied — and no emission factor resolves for it today, so it stays "Not calculated".
